snippet.title: Imperial Takeover | Fortnite Galactic Battle Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Driving back the Imperial invasion will take every blaster and ship at your disposal. Unless you feel a strong pull to the dark side… drop into Fortnite Galactic Battle launching today! https://fn.gg/GalacticBattle

Play Fortnite Battle Royale, the completely free 100-player PvP mode. One giant map, A Battle Bus, Last one standing wins. ESRB Rating: Teen with Violence.
